new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/ns"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("ns-a")
.withNamespace("team-a")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("tenant a")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/only-a"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("ns-a-only")
.withNamespace("team-a")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("only a")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/ns"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        -1
)
.withId("ns-g")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("global")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/blank"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        -2
)
.withId("ns-blank")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("blank")
);
